keycloak.description: Keycloak self-service claims (identity.inari.io TenantRealm/TenantClient) on provider-keycloak.

providerConfigRef.description: Name of the provider-keycloak ClusterProviderConfig referenced by composed managed resources.

issuerBaseURL.description: Public base URL of the hub Keycloak (no trailing slash); used to project status.issuerURL. Required when keycloak.enabled=true.

secretDelivery.description: ESO-based delivery of client credentials into tenant namespaces (server-rendered SecretStore + ExternalSecret; see examples/).
